therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: Tumor cells via oncolytic herpes simplex virus
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Oncolytic viral therapy with selective tumor cell lysis and immune activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Direct tumor cell destruction and enhancement of anti-tumor immune response in combination with chemoradiotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

results.effect_size: Not analyzed due to early termination with 5 participants
subgroup_findings: Clinical complete response: 1/2 in combination arm vs 2/3 in control arm
Metabolic complete response: 1/2 in combination arm vs 1/3 in control arm
results.dose_information: Talimogene Laherparepvec administered by intratumoral injection; Cisplatin by intravenous infusion; 70 grays radiation in 35 fractions over 7 weeks
